shadowHints.message: mise provides its own Go. `mise uninstall go` (or removing go from mise.toml) hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts mise's Go instead.
asdf provides its own Go through shims. `asdf uninstall golang` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts asdf's Go instead.
Homebrew's Go comes first. `brew uninstall go` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts Homebrew's Go instead.
Another Go in /usr/local/bin (Homebrew on Intel, or a manual symlink) comes first. Remove it, or adopt that installation with `vfox link <version> <path>`.
The official Go in /usr/local/go comes first. Remove it, or adopt it with `vfox link --detect golang`.
The system package manager's Go comes first. Remove the system golang package, or adopt it with `vfox link --detect golang`.
goenv's Go comes first. `goenv uninstall <version>` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts goenv's Go instead.
gvm's Go comes first. `gvm uninstall <version>` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts gvm's Go instead.
snap's Go comes first. `snap remove go` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts snap's Go instead.
Scoop's Go comes first. `scoop uninstall go` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts Scoop's Go instead.
Chocolatey's Go comes first. `choco uninstall golang` hands `go` back to vfox; `vfox link --detect golang` adopts it instead.
A machine-wide Go under Program Files comes first. Uninstall it, or adopt it with `vfox link --detect golang`.
